   "source": [
    "# Crystal plasticity formulations\n",
    "\n",
    "There are two common ways to formulate crystal plasticity kinematics:\n",
    "\n",
    "1. **Approximated** — split the kinematics into two coupled rate equations, one\n",
    "   for the elastic stretch and one for the crystal *orientation*, integrated in\n",
    "   *additive* rate form. This is the small-elastic-strain approximation of the\n",
    "   multiplicative decomposition.\n",
    "2. **Exact** — integrate the plastic deformation gradient $F_p$ directly from the\n",
    "   plastic spatial velocity gradient $l_p$, using the full $F = F_e F_p$\n",
    "   multiplicative decomposition with no kinematic approximation.\n",
    "\n",
    "Both rest on the multiplicative decomposition $F = F_e F_p$. The first form is\n",
    "cheaper and integrates additively, but assumes the elastic strains are small; the\n",
    "second makes no such assumption.\n",
    "\n",
    "A NEML2 crystal model can be written either way while reusing the *same*\n",
    "constitutive pieces — the slip rule, the hardening law, the crystal geometry.\n",
    "Only a few specialized sub-models differ. Here we run equivalent approximated and\n",
    "exact models through the same rolling history (to 50% rolling strain),\n",
    "reconstruct the deformed textures, and compare. Because the elastic strains stay\n",
    "small here, the approximation should be excellent and the two should agree.\n",
    "\n",
    "The two models are defined in input files alongside this notebook,\n",
    "[`crystal_approximated.i`](crystal_approximated.i) and\n",
    "[`crystal_exact.i`](crystal_exact.i). Each defines just the `NonlinearSystem` —\n",
    "the load history and the time integration live here on the Python side, driven by\n",
    "[pyzag](https://github.com/Argonne-National-Laboratory/pyzag). For more on the\n",
    "pyzag driver see the\n",
    "[pyzag tutorial](#tutorials-optimization-pyzag).\n",
    "\n",
    "```{note}\n",
    "This is a heavier example (500 crystals, 2500 time steps) and is committed\n",
    "pre-executed; it runs on the GPU when one is available.\n",
    "```"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Setup\n",
    "\n",
    "This example simulates rolling in an FCC material. `rate` is the strain rate,\n",
    "`total_rolling_strain` the reduction strain, `ntime` the number of time steps,\n",
    "`ncrystal` the number of random initial orientations, and `nchunk` the pyzag\n",
    "vectorized time-integration chunk size."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {

    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "from matplotlib.lines import Line2D\n",
    "import torch\n",
    "\n",
    "import neml2\n",
    "from neml2.types import MRP, R2, SR2, WR2, Scalar, compose, r2_from_sr2, r2_from_wr2\n",
    "from neml2.pyzag import NEML2PyzagModel\n",
    "import neml2.texture as texture\n",
    "from pyzag import nonlinear, chunktime\n",
    "\n",
    "torch.manual_seed(0)\n",
    "torch.set_default_dtype(torch.double)\n",
    "device = torch.device(\"cuda:0\" if torch.cuda.is_available() else \"cpu\")\n",
    "print(f\"Using device: {device}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "nchunk = 10\n",
    "ncrystal = 500\n",
    "\n",
    "rate = 0.0001\n",
    "total_rolling_strain = 0.5\n",
    "ntime = 2500\n",
    "end_time = total_rolling_strain / rate"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### The deformation history\n",
    "\n",
    "Rolling is an isochoric stretch: extension in one transverse direction balanced\n",
    "by contraction in the rolling direction, with no spin. We build the deformation\n",
    "rate (an `SR2`) and the vorticity (a `WR2`); the exact model additionally needs\n",
    "the deformation gradient $F$, which we obtain by integrating the spatial velocity\n",
    "gradient $l = \\dot\\varepsilon + w$ with the exponential map.\n",
    "\n",
    "The 500 initial orientations are sampled uniformly on $SO(3)$ with `MRP.rand`."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-03T18:21:55.767561Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-03T18:21:55.767342Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-03T18:21:55.828572Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-03T18:21:55.827781Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Deformation rate (symmetric) and vorticity (skew), as typed batched tensors\n",
    "# over (ntime, ncrystal). Rolling: +rate along y, -rate along z, no spin.\n",
    "deformation_rate = torch.zeros((ntime, ncrystal, 6), device=device)\n",
    "deformation_rate[:, :, 1] = rate\n",
    "deformation_rate[:, :, 2] = -rate\n",
    "deformation_rate = SR2(deformation_rate)\n",
    "vorticity = WR2(torch.zeros((ntime, ncrystal, 3), device=device))\n",
    "times = torch.linspace(0, end_time, ntime, device=device).unsqueeze(-1).expand(ntime, ncrystal)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Uniformly random initial orientations (modified Rodrigues parameters).\n",
    "initial_orientations = MRP.rand(ncrystal, device=device)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-03T18:21:55.832507Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-03T18:21:55.832283Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-03T18:21:56.344690Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-03T18:21:56.343238Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# The exact model is driven by the deformation gradient F. Build it from the\n",
    "# spatial velocity gradient l = sym(deformation_rate) + skew(vorticity) using the\n",
    "# typed SR2/WR2 -> R2 reconstructions, then integrate with the matrix exponential.\n",
    "spatial_velocity_gradient = r2_from_sr2(deformation_rate).data + r2_from_wr2(vorticity).data\n",
    "F = torch.zeros_like(spatial_velocity_gradient)\n",
    "F[0] = torch.eye(3, device=device)\n",
    "dt = torch.diff(times, dim=0)\n",
    "Finc = torch.linalg.matrix_exp(spatial_velocity_gradient[:-1] * dt[..., None, None])\n",
    "for i in range(1, ntime):\n",
    "    F[i] = Finc[i - 1] @ F[i - 1]\n",
    "F = R2(F)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### pyzag helpers\n",
    "\n",
    "pyzag integrates a NEML2 `NonlinearSystem` through the load history. The\n",
    "`NEML2PyzagModel` adapts the system to pyzag's solver and bridges the typed\n",
    "NEML2 surface and pyzag's flat tensors:\n",
    "\n",
    "- `factory.assemble_forces` packs a `{name: tensor}` dict (each force tensor\n",
    "  shaped `(ntime, ncrystal, *base)`) into pyzag's flat force layout.\n",
    "- `factory.assemble_state` packs a `{name: tensor}` dict of initial conditions\n",
    "  (each shaped `(ncrystal, *base)`, one entry per state variable) into the flat\n",
    "  initial state.\n",
    "- `extract` slices a named variable back out of the integrated `(..., nstate)`\n",
    "  history.\n",
    "\n",
    "`make_solver` builds the chunked Newton-Raphson solver."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-03T18:21:56.347954Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-03T18:21:56.347805Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-03T18:21:56.352713Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-03T18:21:56.351292Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def extract(pmodel, history, name):\n",
    "    offset = 0\n",
    "    for var in pmodel.slayout.vars():\n",
    "        size = pmodel.slayout.var_size(var)\n",
    "        if var == name:\n",
    "            return history[..., offset : offset + size]\n",
    "        offset += size\n",
    "    raise KeyError(name)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def make_solver(pmodel):\n",
    "    return nonlinear.RecursiveNonlinearEquationSolver(\n",
    "        pmodel,\n",
    "        step_generator=nonlinear.StepGenerator(nchunk),\n",
    "        predictor=nonlinear.PreviousStepsPredictor(),\n",
    "        nonlinear_solver=chunktime.ChunkNewtonRaphson(rtol=1.0e-6, atol=1.0e-8),\n",
    "    )"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Approximated formulation\n",
    "\n",
    "The approximated model carries the elastic strain, the slip hardening, and the\n",
    "crystal orientation as unknowns, integrating coupled rate equations for each in\n",
    "additive form. The orientation is seeded with the random initial texture; the\n",
    "deformation rate and vorticity drive the model."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-03T18:21:56.356068Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-03T18:21:56.355934Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-03T18:23:26.017604Z",

To keep donated buffers enabled, restore torch._functorch.config._config['donated_buffer'].default = True -- compiled models differentiated through the adjoint will then error.\n",
      "  return nonlinear.RecursiveNonlinearEquationSolver(\n"
     ]

   ],
   "source": [
    "nmodel_approx = neml2.load_nonlinear_system(\"crystal_approximated.i\", \"eq_sys\")\n",
    "nmodel_approx.model.to(device=device)\n",
    "pmodel_approx = NEML2PyzagModel(nmodel_approx)\n",
    "\n",
    "forces_approx = pmodel_approx.assemble_forces(\n",
    "    {\"deformation_rate\": deformation_rate.data, \"vorticity\": vorticity.data, \"t\": times}\n",
    ")\n",
    "state0_approx = pmodel_approx.assemble_state(\n",
    "    {\n",
    "        \"elastic_strain\": torch.zeros(ncrystal, 6, device=device),\n",
    "        \"slip_hardening\": torch.zeros(ncrystal, device=device),\n",
    "        \"orientation\": initial_orientations.data,\n",
    "    }\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "with torch.no_grad():\n",
    "    history_approx = nonlinear.solve_adjoint(\n",
    "        make_solver(pmodel_approx), state0_approx, len(forces_approx), forces_approx\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "orientations_approx = MRP(extract(pmodel_approx, history_approx, \"orientation\")[-1])\n",
    "print(\"approximated final orientations:\", tuple(orientations_approx.data.shape))"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We reconstruct a continuous orientation distribution function (ODF) from the\n",
    "discrete final orientations with a kernel density estimate. The\n",
    "de la Vallee Poussin kernel half-width is fixed (rather than cross-validated) so\n",
    "the two formulations are compared on equal footing."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-03T18:23:26.020993Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-03T18:23:26.020542Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-03T18:23:26.024749Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-03T18:23:26.023835Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "odf_approx = texture.KDEODF(\n",
    "    orientations_approx, texture.DeLaValleePoussinKernel(torch.tensor(0.2, device=device))\n",
    ")\n",
    "odf_approx.kernel.h = torch.tensor(0.23, device=device)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Exact formulation\n",
    "\n",
    "The exact model carries the slip hardening and the plastic deformation gradient\n",
    "$F_p$ as unknowns; the orientation enters as a fixed reference force `r`. $F_p$ is\n",
    "seeded to the identity. The model is driven by the deformation gradient $F$."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-03T18:23:26.026293Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-03T18:23:26.026168Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-03T18:25:30.124543Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-03T18:25:30.123923Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "exact state history: (2500, 500, 10)\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "nmodel_exact = neml2.load_nonlinear_system(\"crystal_exact.i\", \"eq_sys\")\n",
    "nmodel_exact.model.to(device=device)\n",
    "pmodel_exact = NEML2PyzagModel(nmodel_exact)\n",
    "\n",
    "r_force = MRP(initial_orientations.data.unsqueeze(0).expand(ntime, ncrystal, 3).contiguous())\n",
    "forces_exact = pmodel_exact.assemble_forces({\"r\": r_force.data, \"F\": F.data, \"t\": times})\n",
    "eye = torch.eye(3, device=device).expand(ncrystal, 3, 3).contiguous()\n",
    "state0_exact = pmodel_exact.assemble_state(\n",
    "    {\"tauc\": torch.zeros(ncrystal, device=device), \"Fp\": eye}\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "with torch.no_grad():\n",
    "    history_exact = nonlinear.solve_adjoint(\n",
    "        make_solver(pmodel_exact), state0_exact, len(forces_exact), forces_exact\n",
    "    )\n",
    "print(\"exact state history:\", tuple(history_exact.shape))"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Extracting the orientation from the exact model takes some doing. We recover $F_p$\n",
    "from the final state, form $F_e = F F_p^{-1}$, take the rotation $R_e$ from a polar\n",
    "decomposition of $F_e$, convert it to an MRP with `MRP.from_matrix`, and finally\n",
    "compose it with the initial orientation to get the deformed texture."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-03T18:25:30.126126Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-03T18:25:30.125973Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-03T18:25:30.147905Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-03T18:25:30.147262Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "exact final orientations: (500, 3)\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "def lattice_rotation(Fp_flat, F_now):\n",
    "    # Rotation (as MRP) from the elastic part of F, via polar decomposition of Fe.\n",
    "    Fp = Fp_flat.reshape(Fp_flat.shape[:-1] + (3, 3))\n",
    "    Fe = F_now @ torch.linalg.inv(Fp)\n",
    "    U, _, Vh = torch.linalg.svd(Fe)\n",
    "    return MRP.from_matrix(R2(U @ Vh))\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "Fp_final = extract(pmodel_exact, history_exact, \"Fp\")[-1]\n",
    "Re = lattice_rotation(Fp_final, F.data[-1])\n",
    "orientations_exact = compose(Re, initial_orientations)\n",
    "print(\"exact final orientations:\", tuple(orientations_exact.data.shape))\n",
    "\n",
    "odf_exact = texture.KDEODF(\n",
    "    orientations_exact, texture.DeLaValleePoussinKernel(torch.tensor(0.2, device=device))\n",
    ")\n",
    "odf_exact.kernel.h = torch.tensor(0.23, device=device)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [

   ]

  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Compare the elastic strains\n",
    "\n",
    "Finally we compare the elastic strain histories. For the approximated model the\n",
    "elastic strain is a state variable; for the exact model we recover it from\n",
    "$F_e = F F_p^{-1}$ over the whole history via the Green-Lagrange-like measure\n",
    "$E = \\tfrac12 (U_e^\\top U_e - I)$ of the elastic stretch $U_e$.\n",
    "\n",
    "The per-crystal histories differ slightly between the two measures, but their\n",
    "averages agree — confirming the additive approximation is excellent at these\n",
    "(small) elastic strains."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-03T18:25:41.427862Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-03T18:25:41.427705Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-03T18:25:44.714538Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-03T18:25:44.713836Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Approximated: elastic strain is a state variable (SR2, Mandel order).\n",
    "elastic_strain_approx = SR2(extract(pmodel_approx, history_approx, \"elastic_strain\"))\n",
    "\n",
    "# Exact: recover the elastic stretch over the whole history.\n",
    "Fp_hist = extract(pmodel_exact, history_exact, \"Fp\").reshape(ntime, ncrystal, 3, 3)\n",
    "Fe_hist = F.data @ torch.linalg.inv(Fp_hist)\n",
    "U_hist, S_hist, Vh_hist = torch.linalg.svd(Fe_hist)\n",
    "Ue_hist = Vh_hist.transpose(-2, -1) @ torch.diag_embed(S_hist) @ Vh_hist\n",
    "E_exact = 0.5 * (Ue_hist.transpose(-2, -1) @ Ue_hist - torch.eye(3, device=device))\n",
    "\n",
    "t_axis = times[:, 0].cpu()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",

    "# Elastic strain in the rolling direction (zz), every crystal.\n",
    "plt.plot(t_axis, elastic_strain_approx.data[:, :, 2].cpu(), \"k-\", alpha=0.3)\n",
    "plt.plot(t_axis, E_exact[:, :, 2, 2].cpu(), \"r--\", alpha=0.3)\n",
    "plt.xlabel(\"Time\")\n",
    "plt.ylabel(\"Elastic strain in the rolling direction\")\n",
    "plt.legend(\n",
    "    [Line2D([0], [0], color=\"k\"), Line2D([0], [0], color=\"r\", linestyle=\"--\")],\n",
    "    [\"Approximated\", \"Exact\"],\n",
    "    loc=\"best\",\n",

    "# Averages of the diagonal elastic strain components.\n",
    "for i in range(3):\n",
